card.name: The word to after hypersensitivity
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "to" right after hypersensitivity or allergic, just before the name of the substance. Also fires on a few other words that precede a named object or person, such as "who" or "Weight".

modes.label: to after hypersensitivity
modes.description: The word "to" after hypersensitivity or allergic, introducing the allergen in contraindication text.

modes.label: Other lead-in words
modes.description: Scattered words that lead into a name or table entry, like "Weight" in a dosing table or "who" in a clause.
